newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian dlr, bonds edge up on RBA Bulletin.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian dlr, bonds edge up on RBA Bulletin.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds edged higher in immediate response to the Reserve Bank quarterly Bulletin, which said that monetary policy was broadly appropriate.

It also said it expected a good performance on inflation in the near term and that underlying inflation was expected to be in a 2-3 percent band in 1998, but it also warned that the trade union's "living wage" claim would adversely affect employment.
The report was much in line with comments made by RBA governor Ian Macfarlane last week.
The dollar was US$0.7661/66 compared with US$0.7652/57 just before the report, while the March 10-year bond futures contract was 92.720 from a pre-Bulletin 92.690.
The March bills contract also steadied to 94.06 from 94.05.
